messages:
Morgan H: Heads-up — scheduling a staggered maintenance window for rack cohort az24-east-2c tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Thermal sensors flagged persistent spikes after yesterday's burst tests; we want a controlled cooldown + soft drain to avoid mass preemptions. :thermometer: 
Sanjay P: SGTM. Which pools are in the cohort and any customer-facing capacity impact?
Morgan H: Affected: pool-gpu-highmem-3 (primary), pool-gpu-standard-7 (backfill). We expect 10–12% capacity reduction in that AZ during the window. No public API downtime planned; best-effort routing to other AZs.
Ellie R: Can we run a small canary first (2 nodes) to validate KV cache reseed times? Last time reseed added ~180ms p99.
Morgan H: yep — plan is canary -> 10-node cohort -> full cohort. Canary at 02:00, cohort ramp at 02:10. If reseed p99 > 400ms we abort and rollback.
Rafa: Quick ask — please disable scheduled batch jobs to that pool from 01:50-04:30. Otherwise queued jobs will hit cold-cache.
Lena: noted. I'll update the scheduler exclusion tags.
infra-oncall-bot: Reminder: incident playbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/rack-thermal. Auto page if >5% host failures in 5m.
Sanjay P: What about Dedicated customers pinned to pool-gpu-highmem-3? We need opt-in comms.
Morgan H: Two dedicated tenants: @acct-neo and @acct-cerebro. SEs alerted — they'll send maintenance notices now. We will honor SLA routing and bump them to burst capacity in us-east-1 if needed.
Ellie R: Runbook excerpt: 
```
# drain command for controlled eviction
kubectl drain node-<id> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='app!=critical' --grace-period=120
```
Sanjay P: Who's owning rollback? If thermal doesn't improve after drains, do we re-instate nodes or keep warm-backfill?
Morgan H: Oncall (Lena) owns rollback decision + reheat monitor. Rollback criteria: temps not falling by 15% after 30m OR error rate spike > 1% on inference endpoints.
Lena: I'll run the monitor script and post updates in this thread. Also enabling extra KPI dashboards (latency/cpu/gpu_temp) for the window.
Rafa: Cost note — using burst capacity in other AZs will increase unit cost ~1.4x for that window. Finance flagged but approved for customer SLAs.
Sanjay P: Can we minimize cost by shifting non-critical embeddings jobs to low-priority batch cluster?
Morgan H: Good idea. Ops tag: move embeddings jobs with "priority:low" to batch-west overnight. Lena, can you coordinate with Batch SRE?
Lena: On it — pinging @batch-sre channel and will escalate if they don't ack in 15m.
infra-oncall-bot: Deploybot scheduled: rolling-drain-script v2.3.1 will run at 02:00. See: https://ci.redwood/builds/8723 
Ellie R: I'll watch the canary metrics. If p95 latency for 'chat' increases by >50ms we hit abort and revert routing.
Morgan H: Communication checklist: 1) Post customer emails (SEs) — DONE, 2) Update status page 30m before, 3) Notify marketplace portals — pending.
Sanjay P: Status page update ready? I can push the short blurb.
Morgan H: Please do — "Planned maintenance: az24-east-2c rack cohort cooling and soft drain. No API downtime expected; potential capacity routing to other regions."
Lena: Canary started (02:00) — initial kube drains issued to node-az24-07 and node-az24-09.
Rafa: Observing temp delta — nodes dropped ~12% after fans ramp. Good sign.
Ellie R: Canary p99 reseed = 210ms, p95 latency +18ms. Within thresholds. :thumbsup:
Morgan H: Proceeding with cohort ramp at 02:10. Executing staggered 5-node batches with 5m gap between batches.
infra-oncall-bot: Alert: cohort-ramp batch-2 started (02:15).
Lena: Batch-2 drains completed, backfill pipeline seeding KV caches in us-east-1 running.
Sanjay P: Early telemetry shows a small spike in inference 5xxs (~0.3%). Watching.
Ellie R: That's within expected transient; keeping eye on traces for any model-serving timeouts.
Rafa: Batch-3 in progress. Fan RPMs normalized on drained hosts.
Morgan H: We're 40m into window — temps down ~22% vs baseline. No action needed.
infra-oncall-bot: Notice will auto-post to status page at 01:30 UTC before the window.
Lena: Final batch completed, starting slow rejoin sequence. Reboots avoided; using thermal cooldown + soft-drain worked.
Sanjay P: Thanks team. Postmortem checklist: capture KV reseed timings, customer latency, cost delta for burst usage.
Morgan H: Agreed — I'll create a short ops note and metrics snapshot. Closing thread after postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
